title: Attio customer stories
description: A white framed customer-stories section: a blue badge, a two-tone 40px heading and a small arrow button, then a hairline row of four logo tabs (the picked one greyed; just the marks on phones) over a split of the story's uppercase eyebrow and two-tone headline at the bottom left and a desaturated photo on the right. Picking a tab fades the story in; the photo comes into focus as it scrolls in.
notes: each story's photo is a media slot (695×429, 390×240 on phones), shown at 55% saturation; empty, a grey placeholder
